thread:
Samira: Morning — the communal honey jar is empty again and there are three rogue tea bags in a ziplock (earl grey x1, chamomile x2). Anyone accidentally taken the big honey jar home? :honey_pot:
Ben: Oh nooo, that was me last week. totally forgot to return it. I can swing by with a replacement at ~11:45 if that helps.
Maria: If Ben brings honey I'll grab a box of green tea. Quick poll — does the kitchen want oat milk this week? I'll buy it if most people want it. :raised_hand:
Alex: I'll take oat milk. Also can we standardize jar labeling? a small "communal" sticker would help.
Jamal: +1 on labels. Also can we have a tiny basket for single-serve snacks so they don't get lost in the pantry? keeps things neater.
Samira: Quick vote: react with :one: for Honey+Tea run (Ben+Maria), :two: for Oat milk pickup, :three: to pass but add cookies as a bribe.
KitchenBot: Poll created by Samira — 1: Honey+Tea run, 2: Oat milk pickup, 3: Pass+cookie (poll open for 2 hours).
Ben: (:one:)
Alex: (:two:)
Maria: (:one: :two:) lol both pls
Samira: Thanks! Ben, if you can, grab a squeeze bottle instead of the big jar — smaller, less messy. leaving a mini list below: 
```
- squeeze honey bottle
- green tea box (20 ct)
- oat milk (1L, unsweetened)
- mini cookie pack (optional)
```
Ben: Got it, will grab these. ETA ~11:50 from corner market.
KitchenBot: Reminder set: Ben will pick up the items at ~11:45. :package: 
Alex: I'll make the "communal items" labelling stickers this afternoon and put them on jars. Anyone want icons? :label:
Maria: Love that. Also can we have a small "not for sharing" sticker for labeled meal-prep in the mini-fridge? :laughing:
Samira: Perfect. I'll close the thread once Ben confirms pickup.
Ben: Back — got the squeeze honey bottle, oat milk, green tea, and cookies. Left everything on the counter with a tiny note. :cookie: :coffee:
Samira: Legendary. Thank you!! :heart: :honey_pot:
